name: bria-ai
cost: Free API key. Usage pricing is not stated in the README
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Codex and 37+ other agents
short: Lets your coding agent make and edit images with Bria: text to image, object edits, background removal, upscaling and product shots.
what: Connects your agent to Bria.ai's image models through 20+ API endpoints. It can generate images from text, edit by instruction or mask, add, replace or remove objects, remove backgrounds, upscale, restyle, relight, change the season and restore old photos. It also builds e-commerce product shots and whole catalogs. Bria describes its models as commercially safe and royalty-free.
who: Developers, marketers and shop owners who want images made from inside their coding agent, for websites, product listings or ads.
needs: A Bria API key, free at platform.bria.ai
A coding agent that supports skills

steps.title: Set your key
steps.text: Or just start using it, and the skill walks you through setup.

steps.title: Or add it to Claude Code as an MCP server
steps.code: claude mcp add bria-skills -- npx -y bria-skills

try.label: From the README
try.text: Generate a hero image for a SaaS landing page, 16:9, modern and clean

watch: The images you edit are sent to Bria's API.
Signing in saves your access token and API key in `~/.bria/credentials`.
If your Bria account's billing is blocked, the skill stops and shows Bria's message.
The same marketplace also has remove-background, ad-delayer, ad-resize, vgl and image-utils, which you install separately.
